title: environment_assumptions.json
description: Schema for .ai/blueteam/data/environment_assumptions.json — organizational environment baseline assumptions applied during assessment

deployment_target.description: Inferred deployment target for this application

public_facing.description: True if the application is public-facing; null if unknown

baseline_version.description: Version string of shared/reference/environment-baseline.md used during assessment

assessments_applied.description: List of assessment names (without .md extension) that have written to this file

assumptions.description: Environment baseline assumptions recorded during assessment

id.description: Sequential identifier: ASMP-001, ASMP-002, etc. Preserved across merges.

control.description: CAS rule ID (e.g. WAF-001) or empty string if ASVS-only

asvs_requirements.description: ASVS requirement IDs covered by this assumption; empty array if CAS-only

basis.description: Why this assumption applies, citing shared/reference/environment-baseline.md

verdict_applied.description: The verdict reported in the assessment, e.g. 'ASSUMED COMPLIANT (Environment Baseline)'

validation_required.description: Specific action a human reviewer must take to confirm this assumption

assessment_source.description: Assessment report that recorded this assumption

conflict_detected.description: True if repository evidence conflicts with this assumption

conflict_detail.description: Description of conflict if conflict_detected is true; null otherwise

description.description: Optional human-readable description of the assumption
